ce1bf5283ac9e52e701f0347aba44d6e.overview: A sadistic serial rapist and murderer of young women terrorizes a small province in 1980s South Korea. To prevent further crimes, three increasingly desperate detectives with conflicting methods race against time to unravel the violent mind of the killer in a futile effort to solve the case.
ce1bf5283ac9e52e701f0347aba44d6e.tagline: The worst of them will stay with you... forever.

ce20d927a01b96fa48d92b721223d893.overview: The biography of Dr. W.T. Morgan, a 19th century Boston dentist, during his quest to have anesthesia, in the form of ether, accepted by the public and the medical and dental establishment.
ce20d927a01b96fa48d92b721223d893.tagline: Paramount's escapist laugh tonic! Hilarious as a whiff of laughing gas!

ce257916940f5eb99801543720a00d40.overview: It is 1947, the year of the communist rebellion in Malaya and the British army's SADUSEA (Song And Dance Unit South East Asia) are called to the Malayan Jungle to entertain the troops. The eccentric, bible-bashing Major Giles Flack (John Cleese) is in command of the unit. Flack is accompanied by an ageing, theatrical drama queen, Terri Dennis (Denis Quilley) who hopes to entertain the troops with his flamboyant impressions, but the bored troops find other ways to enjoy themselves.

ce275a2c1eb7051d2ce4d77f48af4f10.overview: A controlling father’s attempts to ensure that his two children succeed in high school backfire after his son experiences a career-ending sports injury. Their familial bonds are eventually placed under severe strain by an unexpected tragedy.

ce2a1d83919112978714a88dbab5518a.overview: An intimate journey through the formative years of David Lynch's life. From his idyllic upbringing in small town America to the dark streets of Philadelphia, we follow Lynch as he traces the events that have helped to shape one of cinema's most enigmatic directors.
ce2a1d83919112978714a88dbab5518a.tagline: Experience a unique documentary event: exploring the life and the mind of the creative genius behind David Lynch.

ce39559354590c9b64b9143fcbba7de2.overview: The true story of how businessman Oskar Schindler saved over a thousand Jewish lives from the Nazis while they worked as slaves in his factory during World War II.
ce39559354590c9b64b9143fcbba7de2.tagline: Whoever saves one life, saves the world entire.

ce746ccc28badef7baf2f3a43cc3d3a5.overview: A married woman and her lover murder her husband and dump his body into a well, but his ghost returns to haunt them as the local gossip intensifies.
ce746ccc28badef7baf2f3a43cc3d3a5.tagline: The haunting of a passionate love.

ce88a007bf517131a673bfe54288b21f.overview: A detailed chronicle of the famous 1969 tour of the United States by the British rock band The Rolling Stones, which culminated with the disastrous and tragic concert held on December 6 at the Altamont Speedway Free Festival, an event of historical significance, as it marked the end of an era: the generation of peace and love suddenly became the generation of disillusionment.
ce88a007bf517131a673bfe54288b21f.tagline: The music that thrilled the world… and the killing that stunned it!

cea8fed2e602ccd2abaedbee3c42404c.overview: When a desperate man’s car breaks down in a bizarre desert town while evading vengeful bookies, he becomes entangled in a dangerous love triangle. Caught between a married couple, he’s faced with deadly contracts to kill them both.
cea8fed2e602ccd2abaedbee3c42404c.tagline: Sex. Murder. Betrayal. Everything that makes life worth living.

cebf088f30627bfd31283ba286f40db2.overview: Mid-level gangster Wah falls in love with his beautiful cousin, but must also continue to protect his volatile partner-in-crime and friend, Fly.

cef169e57fe164e0fd1c406f4d30eb28.overview: A passionate telling of the story of Sada Abe, a woman whose affair with her master led to an obsessive and ultimately destructive sexual relationship.
cef169e57fe164e0fd1c406f4d30eb28.tagline: Never before had a man and a woman loved each other so intensely.
